title: Harness X-Ray calibration
description: The output of scripts/calibrate.mjs: calibration.json, written in a run folder next to calibration.md. It holds the distribution of each measure with a threshold over a sample of targets, and how many targets are above each threshold (scripts/lib/calibration.mjs). It holds numbers, the basename of each target and fixed texts only: no path, no file name inside a target and no text of a target. The percentiles are nearest rank (meta.percentileMethod). A target with no value for a measure is not counted in that measure's n. The constraints that this schema cannot state across fields (exceeding is at most n, a null statistic only when n is 0, the thresholds of each measure, the order of the measures and of the statistics, sample.count) are checked by checkCalibration in scripts/lib/calibration.mjs.

meta.description: The date of the run, the harness that made the scans, the rule catalog they read, and the method of the percentiles.

date.description: The date of the run in UTC, YYYY-MM-DD. The only time in the file.

tool.description: meta.tool of the scans: the name and version of the harness.

catalog.description: meta.catalog of the scans: the number of rule files and the first 12 hex digits of a SHA-256 over them.

sha256.description: The first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256, not the whole digest.

percentileMethod.const: nearest rank: with the n values sorted ascending as v[1] to v[n], the p-th percentile is v[ceil(p * n / 100)]; the median is the 50th percentile
percentileMethod.description: The method of the percentiles, in words. The same text as PERCENTILE_METHOD in scripts/lib/calibration.mjs.

sample.description: The targets of the sample: their number and their basenames, sorted by code unit.

targets.description: The basename of each target, sorted, one item per target. Two targets with the same basename are two items. A basename holds no folder separator and no control or format character.

measures.description: One entry per measure, sorted by name. There are six measures, each once.

measure.description: The distribution of one measure over the targets that have a value. n is that number of targets. The statistics are null when n is 0. max is the largest value, min the smallest; p25, median, p75 and p90 are nearest-rank percentiles. Notes by measure (the document repeats them): largeFileCount counts the files above the current largeFileBytes, so it cannot support a new byte value on its own: a new value needs the distribution of file sizes. skillDescriptionMaxChars counts a skill over the listing cut (overLimit) as well, which CTX-04 reports as truncated (medium) and not as long (low), because such a skill is above 1,024 characters too.

n.description: The number of targets with a value for this measure. At most sample.count.

thresholds.description: The thresholds that this measure is compared with, sorted by key, one item per key.

statistic.description: A value of the measure, or null when n is 0.

threshold.description: A threshold of the rules: its value in THRESHOLDS, its status, and the number of targets whose value is above it (value > threshold). For largeFileBytes, the number of targets with at least one file above it. For skillDescriptionMaxChars, a skill over the listing cut is counted too (see the note of its measure).

value.description: The current value of the threshold in THRESHOLDS.

exceeding.description: The number of targets with a value above the threshold. At most n of the measure.
